chamber_readouts_predict_direction.note: leave-one-culture-out logistic regression on the chamber readouts, predicting the sign of the measured axonal flow; the null shuffles signs within each culture

axonal_directionality.label: REAL - measured axonal crossings, not simulated

stored_coordinate_disagreements.note: files whose stored coordinates contradict their own channel names; position is taken from the names, which never disagree with the convention

baseline_activity.label: untreated baseline activity, human vs rat

preparation_within_human.slice: human only, Axion: 3D organoid vs 2D monolayer

pooled_heterogeneous_vs_homogeneous.test: Mann-Whitney U, two-sided, one value per device

cross_lab_transfer.label: REAL pairs, trained on one laboratory and tested on the others
cross_lab_transfer.reads_as: Each test class comes from one laboratory, so laboratory identity alone would score perfectly and only a low score carries information. This score is low: the model failed although the confound was helping it.

within_source_control.reads_as: same classes and sample size, no laboratory crossed; compare with the cross-laboratory score to separate small-sample failure from laboratory shift

demo_precompute.label: precomputed demo inputs; simulated grid plus real-recording posteriors

posterior_draws.reads_as: rejection sampling could not place enough mass inside the prior for these recordings; missing draws are NaN rather than dropped

extractor_agreement.label: REAL recordings, our extractor against the depositors' meaRtools output
extractor_agreement.question: does features/mea.py reproduce the numbers an independent implementation computed from the same spike files

burst_duration_s.note: too few points or doses to fit a trend

feature_dose_response.label: REAL bicuculline recordings, features against dose
feature_dose_response.question: does the dose signal exist in the summary features, or only fail to be recovered by the twin's posterior

verdict.reading: no feature moves monotonically with dose after correction, so there is no dose signal in these summaries for any estimator to recover

harness_quick.label: wall clock and environment for the most recent complete --quick run

label_source_confounding.note: share of pairs whose source is the most common source for their label; a pooled cross-source classifier would be scored on this confound

microchannel_directionality.batch_confound: control chips appear only in experiments 9-11 and the asymmetric geometries only in 1-8 and 12, so condition is confounded with culture batch by the deposit's design

comparison.ci_method: percentile bootstrap over chips, neuromps.models.bootstrap conventions
comparison.statistic: median |asymmetry| per chip; sign is unanchored

microchannel_directionality.criterion: the deposit's own: an event on all 5 electrodes of a microchannel with <=1 ms between consecutive electrodes
microchannel_directionality.direction_note: sign is unanchored: the deposit does not record how each device was seated on the array, so only the magnitude of the asymmetry is comparable across chips

event_count_confound.reads_as: a negative correlation means chips with fewer propagation events look more one-sided, which is what a counting artefact looks like

geometry_robustness.note: orientation and dead-electrode tolerance are assumptions the deposit does not settle; 'one_missing' takes the best four-of-five ordered chain, which is optimistic by construction and bounds the sensitivity rather than improving it

microchannel_directionality.label: REAL recordings: microchannel propagation asymmetry by device geometry

per_recording_naive.ci_method: percentile bootstrap over chips, neuromps.models.bootstrap conventions
per_recording_naive.statistic: median |asymmetry| per chip; sign is unanchored

well_sampled_half.ci_method: percentile bootstrap over chips, neuromps.models.bootstrap conventions
well_sampled_half.statistic: median |asymmetry| per chip; sign is unanchored

across_sources.note: trained on kapucu2022 cortical delta.mfr_hz, tested on fofie2025 sensory neuron rate change; one feature, and a different preparation

rate_only_arm.caveat: sensory neurons, not cortical: what is shared with the rest of the asset is the compound mechanism, not the preparation or the network
rate_only_arm.label: REAL hiPSC sensory-neuron wells, rate change only
rate_only_arm.question: does a firing-rate change alone carry mechanism, and does it carry it to a preparation the model has not seen

run_all_timings_full.label: wall-clock seconds per stage, most recent full run of each

tunnel_rate_tracking.label: coupling asymmetry against chamber rate imbalance, four-chamber cultures with instrumented tunnels

twin_hd11_validation.finding: coupling asymmetry tracks the compartments' relative firing rate as much as the pathway ratio: with equal drive a strongly directed pathway can read as reversed, because the target compartment also receives the pathway's excitation
twin_hd11_validation.label: SIMULATED - not measured data

twin_hd12_calibration.label: SIMULATED - calibration of a model, not measured data
twin_hd12_calibration.note: random search over 9 parameters, each draw scored on 2 network seed(s); everything else held at its module default. detection_radius_um is a property of the virtual electrode, not of the culture, and is capped at 100 um - half the electrode pitch - so no neuron is heard by two electrodes.

twin_hd13_perturbation.label: SIMULATED twin vs REAL pharmacology (directions only)

twin_hd14_inference.label: SIMULATED - inference trained on simulations only

twin_hd15_real_inference.caveat: HD14 identifies gabaa_scale only weakly (contraction 0.3) and it is not among the 3 of 5 parameters passing the rank-uniformity check, so these medians are directional evidence at best

distribution_check.support_note: unsupported_dimensions pass the range test but fewer than 5% of simulated draws land in the real interquartile range, so the posterior is still interpolating across a gap there

twin_hd15_real_inference.expected: a GABA-A antagonist should lower gabaa_scale, and lower it further with dose
twin_hd15_real_inference.label: posterior trained on SIMULATIONS, applied to REAL recordings

prior_acceptance.note: share of raw posterior draws inside the prior box; low values mean the posterior is extrapolating outside its training region for real inputs

arms.free_rate: asymmetric wiring left to raise the target chamber's firing rate
arms.rate_matched: target drive lowered so the rate imbalance matches symmetric

twin_hd16_directionality.label: SIMULATED - directionality discrimination, ground-truth wiring known
twin_hd16_directionality.question: can MEA summary features tell symmetric from asymmetric connectivity
twin_hd16_directionality.rate_only_is_the_validity_check: in the rate-matched arm the rate_only AUC should fall towards chance; if it does not, the matching failed and that arm says nothing about direction

held_out_checks.note: contraction and rank uniformity, as §7.5 reports them for the absolute posterior

twin_hd17_delta_inference.label: posterior trained on PAIRED SIMULATIONS, applied to REAL recordings
twin_hd17_delta_inference.question: does inferring the drug knob from a change against the same chip's own baseline fix what §7.5 found, where absolute summaries put untreated chips at 0.3781

gabaa_scale_dose_trend.expected_direction: falls with dose (a GABA-A antagonist lowers the knob)

twin_hd18_depression.caveat: the weights were calibrated without depression, so this shows the direction the mechanism pushes, not what a re-calibrated model would score
twin_hd18_depression.label: SIMULATED - a model comparison, not measured data
twin_hd18_depression.question: does Tsodyks-Markram depression on recurrent excitatory synapses move pct_spikes_in_bursts and synchrony_index toward the real band

uncertainty_and_ablations.note: with 73 pairs the calibration set is small, so neighbouring alphas can share a threshold; set size, not coverage, is the informative quantity here
